rules.outside_visible: text box > 8 px beyond the visible rect: FAIL when the profile's fail_outside_visible is true (measured/derived visible rect), else WARN
rules.touching_crop: 4-8 px beyond the visible rect: WARN (inside Vision's 4-px box grid, a sliver of a glyph)
rules.under_overlay: WARN when >= 25% of a text box's area lies under an overlay
rules.persistence: an event counts only when it holds on >= 2 consecutive 2-fps samples
